ai_overview_references.title: Agency Proof Sheet: Phoenix AZ, hvac repair and replacement

answer_text:
Perplexity cites varying numbers of distinct domains depending on the specific market and question panel in Namebeam's dataset (for instance, tracking individual city niche panels like Denver or Phoenix lists top domains such as consumeraffairs.com, expertise.com, and local business sites across 23–28 run days).
Namebeam's daily AI visibility records and datasets are published and hosted online at the Namebeam Market Panels and via Namebeam on Hugging Face.
If you can specify the exact market or niche (e.g., Dallas roofing, Phoenix HVAC, or a specific prompt from the dataset), I can look up the exact domain count for that panel.
prompt_text: According to Namebeam's AI Visibility Record, how many different web domains did Perplexity cite in its answers to the record's daily questions from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27? Give the number and say where it is published.
